dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Agentry v{{version}} · up {{uptime}}
dashboard.notLoggedIn: Claude Code is not logged in
dashboard.cliAlertTitle: Claude Code CLI was not detected
dashboard.cliAlertDefault: The `claude` binary is not available in PATH.
dashboard.cliAlertHint: Install it in the container or set CLAUDE_BIN.
dashboard.loginAlertHint: Run claude setup-token on your machine and pass the token to the container as CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, or add it in Config → Account.
dashboard.noUsageHint: Rate-limit windows appear after the first run.

agents.title: Agents in progress
agents.noLiveRunsHint: Runs started through the API or this UI show up here.
agents.noSubagentsHint: Agents spawned with the Agent tool — by a run, or by a terminal session that is live or ended in the last day — are tracked here. The ones a workflow launched are listed under Workflows.
agents.name: Name

tasks.title: Background tasks
tasks.subtitle: {{running}} running · {{total}} total across runs and CLI sessions
tasks.emptyHint: Commands sent to the background — by a run, or by a session started from a terminal — appear here. Long commands that run in the foreground are not listed, even though the CLI reports them as tasks. Agents are listed under Agents, and workflows under Workflows.

workflows.title: Workflows
workflows.subtitle: {{running}} running · {{total}} across runs and CLI sessions — scripts started with Claude Code's Workflow tool
workflows.emptyHint: When a run, or a session started from a terminal, runs a workflow, it shows here with the progress of every agent it launched.
workflows.argsHint: Optional: handed to the script as `args` (text or JSON)
workflows.modelHint: For the run that launches it; the script can pick its own per agent
workflows.savedIntro: Scripts in a project's .claude/workflows/ and in your own, which Claude runs with the Workflow tool. Running one starts a run that launches it, so its prompts come to this panel.
workflows.projectHint: Its own workflows are listed first; yours are available everywhere
workflows.noSavedHint: Save one from a session with the Workflow tool, or write a script in .claude/workflows/.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.continueHint: Pick this conversation up in a run you control from the panel
sessions.activeTitle: Sessions with a live process right now
sessions.searchPlaceholder: Search title, first prompt, project, id…
sessions.temporaryTooltip: Sessions of projects under the OS temp directory
sessions.internalTooltip: Housekeeping sessions of the wrapper itself (planner, auth check)
sessions.noActiveHint: Nothing is running right now. Past sessions are one click away, or start a <link>new run</link>.
sessions.noSessionsHint: Sessions appear here once Claude Code has run in a project.

sessionView.resumeIntro: Starts a run that picks this conversation up with its whole history. From then on you answer its questions and permissions, interrupt it and change its mode or model from the panel.
sessionView.openElsewhere: This session is still open in a terminal. To hand it over, close it there first (/exit) and continue it as is. Otherwise continue in a copy: a new session with the same history that leaves the terminal's untouched.
sessionView.placeholder: Next message for Claude… (drop or paste files to attach them)

runView.placeholderQueued: Send a message (queued until the current turn ends)…
runView.placeholderResume: Send a message — the session will be resumed…
runView.notFoundHint: Runs live in memory and are lost when the wrapper restarts. <link>Browse sessions</link> to resume the conversation.
runView.interruptHint: End this turn and keep the session open for your next message

newRun.title: New run
newRun.subtitle: Starts a headless `claude -p` process managed by the wrapper
newRun.promptHint: Drop or paste files onto the prompt to attach them.
newRun.modelHint: Alias or full model id. Empty = CLI default
newRun.permissionModeHint: Can be changed while the run works
newRun.name: Name
newRun.accountHint: Pins the run to one claude-swap account instead of the active one
newRun.askHere: Answer permission prompts, questions and plans from the panel (off: whatever would ask is denied)
newRun.keepAlive: Keep the process alive between turns (faster follow-ups)

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle_one: {{count}} projects · workspace directories and directories with Claude Code history; worktrees are listed under their repository
projects.subtitle_other: {{count}} projects · workspace directories and directories with Claude Code history; worktrees are listed under their repository
projects.name: Name
projects.nameHint: Directory name inside the workspace: letters, digits, dashes, dots and underscores.
projects.gitUrlHint: Cloned into the new directory. Leave empty for an empty project.
projects.temporaryTooltip: Projects under the OS temp directory
projects.emptyHint: Projects appear once a session has run in a directory.
